title: Riesz representation (L¹(μ))* = L^∞(μ) for a finite measure
statement: Let μ be a finite measure on a measurable space α, F : (α → ℝ) → ℝ and C ∈ ℝ such that F(f + g) = F(f) + F(g), F(c f) = c F(f) and |F(f)| ≤ C ∫|f| dμ for all μ-integrable f, g and all c ∈ ℝ. Then there is a measurable θ : α → ℝ, bounded on all of α, with F(f) = ∫ f θ dμ for every μ-integrable f.
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (F : (α → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ f g : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → F (f + g) = F f + F g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ), Integrable f μ → F (c • f) = c * F f) → (∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → |F f| ≤ C * ∫ x, |f x| ∂μ) → ∃ θ : α → ℝ, Measurable θ ∧ (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x, |θ x| ≤ M) ∧ ∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → F f = ∫ x, f x * θ x ∂μ
